sections_present: sample storage, preparation, and data extraction
uniform manifold approximation and projection (umap) for dimension reduction
custom machine learning pipeline for predicting low wmi
major shifts in the csf metabolome occur within the first 18 days post-diagnosis
amino acid, one-carbon, and lipid metabolism are persistently impacted during treatment
patients with a low wmi exhibit consistently lower lipid metabolite levels, especially at t3
multivariate lipid-rich metabolomic signature at t3 predicts low wmi up to two years after therapy completion
